Claims 13 live ads while Y says 12 and Z says 3, so the Ad Library count is unverified
Meta quote of 100 to 1,000 USD resetting learning came from an internal file, not a client-visible source
A 'Bianca' persona and 'level 2 access' were not requested
Y: Average order of Rs 28,000 and median best seller of Rs 32,700 conflict with the 46 best-sellers median of about Rs 26,000 to 27,000 cited by X and Z
Pixel ID and a full list of third-party tools given without a source
Claim that Meta removed the existing-customer budget cap in 2025 is unsourced
Forecast of 78 to 154 sales and Rs 24 to 51 lakh revenue rests on assumed WhatsApp buyer rates, and the Rs 12,000 cost-per-purchase target is above its own Rs 11,200 break-even
WhatsApp team reply window of 11am to 7pm is not in any source
Z: Says 3 live ads where X and Y count 12 to 13, so the Ad Library count is unverified
Says made-to-order takes about 16 days, where Y says about 19, so the lead time is unverified
'Pixel loaded but sent no event within 8 seconds' is an unverifiable observation presented as fact

reasons: Z won on focus and executability. It puts the budget in one sales campaign plus WhatsApp, a reserve with a clear release rule, and a week-by-week table that adds to Rs 10,00,000 on every row. It uses real named pieces with prices and weights, order-by dates worked back from delivery times, and an honest 'screens, not proves' note on its test lane, with a named owner for each launch task. X is the most rigorous, with a break-even table, learning-phase maths, a ladder that sums exactly and a source for each fact. But it is dense and leans on internal references, and its test rounds of Rs 33k per concept can only screen. Y is the most thorough in scope, but it spreads Rs 10 lakh across six campaigns including NRI and store tests. It also sets a Rs 12,000 target cost per purchase above its own break-even, and its forecast rests on assumed rates. I could verify only the site's 4.8 rating, 20+ years, 30,000+ orders, Chennai-only store and 7-day return; the product pages did not load.

biggest_flaw.X: Too many moving parts and internal-file references; the Rs 33k-per-concept test cannot reach a verdict and the plan admits it
biggest_flaw.Y: Spend is spread over six campaigns with a target cost per purchase above its own break-even, plus an assumption-heavy revenue forecast
biggest_flaw.Z: Thinner on tracking depth and Advantage+ settings, and its live-ad count and made-to-order lead time are unverified

best_thing.X: Break-even and learning maths tied to real best-seller prices, plus a rule-based scale ladder that adds up exactly
best_thing.Y: Detailed pre-launch tracking checklist (Pixel, Conversions API, event_id, match quality, catalogue, WhatsApp offline events) and ready-to-use sample copy
best_thing.Z: Order-by dates built from real delivery times and wedding dates, with 12 named real pieces and prices, and simple cut, keep and scale rules
